title: New rules for the EU’s pharmaceutical sector
content: The Parliament has adopted new rules for the EU’s pharmaceutical industry that will help increase access to medicines, cut red tape and tackle medicine shortages better. They will also introduce stronger incentives for products such as antibiotics, rare disease medicines and treatments for children.

title: Commission to introduce provisional import quotas on hybrid passenger vehicles in December
content: New import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles into the EU will enter into force on 1 December. These restrictions are needed to protect EU producers against a sharp recent increase in the import of such vehicles. The quotas will apply to all hybrid imports regardless of their origin.

title: European Citizens' Panel on democratic resilience submit final recommendations
content: Around 150 EU citizens, randomly selected from all 27 EU countries, have submitted their recommendations on how to strengthen the EU’s democratic life and foster citizen participation, following 3 months of deliberation. The recommendations will inform the Commission's work on democratic resilience.

title: EU and Indonesia sign trade and investment agreements
content: The EU and Indonesia have signed landmark trade and investment agreements, marking an important step towards strengthening economic ties with Southeast Asia's largest economy. The agreements will improve market access, create new opportunities for businesses, and support economic diversification.

title: Equal Pay Day: Would you work for free until next year?
content: This year, 20 November is the day of the year on which women in Europe symbolically stop to be paid compared to men, because of the difference in their annual earnings. It’s the EU’s Equal Pay Day, when we reaffirm our commitment to making equal pay a reality for every woman and every worker.

title: EU measures to protect vulnerable adults get go-ahead
content: New EU rules will guarantee the rights of adults who require support with decision-making. They will help ensure adults in need of assistance are better protected in cross-border situations when it comes to medical care, managing property, and moving to another country.

title: New law on the e-declaration of posted workers
content: A new EU law will facilitate the e-declaration of posted workers. This procedure will reduce the red tape and costs for companies that temporarily assign staff to another EU country. It will also facilitate the freedom to provide services in the single market while protecting posted workers’ rights.

title: European Antibiotic Awareness Day: taking action against antimicrobial resistance
content: European Antibiotic Awareness Day on November 18 raises awareness and understanding of antimicrobial resistance and encourages action to prevent its emergence and spread. Find out what the EU is doing to combat antimicrobial resistance, which causes 35 000 deaths in the EU/EEA every year.

title: New plan for sport in Europe
content: The Commission has set out its vision for European sport, which represents 3.4% of GDP and 6 million jobs. It defines the necessary actions to reinforce the European sport model and prepare it for future challenges, focused on governance, sustainability and solidarity, and sport and society.

title: Autumn economic forecast: continued growth amid higher inflation
content: The autumn 2026 economic forecast shows that the EU economy held up better than expected in the first three quarters of 2026. It is set to keep expanding, despite stronger and more persistent inflationary pressures and tighter financing conditions.

content: Europe’s next generation of startup founders won recognition in Lisbon at the EIT Jumpstarter 2026 awards. The winners come from 12 countries, and their innovations include a test predicting chemotherapy resistance (Spain) and an AI assistant helping operators learn robotic welding faster (Ukraine).

title: Making your online experience fairer
content: The European Commission has proposed the Digital Fairness Act that will help ensure that whether you shop online or in a physical store, you will be guaranteed the same high level of consumer protection. Measures include ensuring transparent pricing and a ban on manipulative marketing tactics.

title: EU to push for accelerated global climate action at COP31
content: At the UN climate change conference in Antalya, Türkiye, 9-20 November, the EU will work with international partners to accelerate global climate action and deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement. “We are committed to making this COP deliver,” said Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.

title: European Innovation Council launches €1.8 billion in funding for 2027
content: The European Innovation Council has launched €1.8 billion in funding for 2027 to support Europe's most promising deep tech entrepreneurs and researchers. The funding will help turn breakthrough research into market-ready innovations and strengthen Europe's ability to scale strategic technologies.

title: New plan to boost sustainable tourism in Europe
content: Europe is the world's leading travel destination and tourism is one of its greatest strategic economic assets. title: Commission and European Space Agency launch new website on climate change research

title: EU future enlargement: Countries' progress on the EU path
content: Enlargement is a merit-based process where enlargement countries must align with EU values and legislation to become an EU Member State. The European Commission has assessed the progress made over the past year by countries looking to join the EU and set out reform priorities for the way forward.

content: As Europe faces increasingly frequent crises, the European Commission has presented new guidelines to help people and communities prepare for emergencies. The guidelines include advice on what essentials to pack for a 72-hour emergency and making sure persons with disabilities are not excluded.

title: EU-funded research advancing our understanding of liver cancer

title: Newborn immunisation against respiratory virus could cut infant winter hospitalisations

title: A stronger Frontex for better protection of the EU’s external borders
